description: Access and manage your Simply-Useful account from ChatGPT. Organize your day in plain language: review your agenda and priorities, catch up on overdue work, and see what others have assigned to you — all in one ask. Create and schedule tasks as you think of them, group them into projects, add checklists and tags, and send appointments straight to your Google Calendar. You can also hand tasks to your contacts and follow up with comments; anything that affects another person asks for your confirmation first. Every change syncs instantly with the Simply-Useful mobile and web apps.
